To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the control strategy has a significant influence on the power cycling results, and the results of the different control strategies can be explained by the different thermal stress applied during the tests.
power cycling results for different test setups and different test strategies can vary by a factor 3.
the lifetime of a power module depends on its operating temperature, the temperature difference between operation and storage, the duration of storage and the number of power cycles.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the influence of the control strategy applied in power cycling tests?
the following questions: How can the lifetime of power modules be determined?

the development and implementation of control strategies for lifetime tests on power modules, and the investigation of the influence of different control strategies on the results of power cycling tests.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the lifetime is not only a function of the temperature swings but also of the applied control strategy.
the lifetime of the power module is not only determined by the temperature swing and the number of cycles, but also by the control strategy applied.
there is no single best control strategy, but a control strategy that fits the application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a control strategy should be chosen that allows for the fastest ramp rates possible without exceeding the maximum junction temperature of the device.
the power cycling test is a powerful and reliable method to characterize the power cycling lifetime of power modules, but the control strategy applied has to be considered.
the lifetime is not a material constant, it is a function of the control strategy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the control strategy has a significant impact on the lifetime of a power module.
the control strategy has a major influence on the lifetime results and that the lifetime curves published by module manufacturers have to be considered as guidelines only.
the lifetime curves provided by the manufacturers are not sufficient to estimate the lifetime of power modules.
